rules.coverage_note: Authored module providers object entry; provider alias/address normalization remains generic resolver work.

gaps: provider-computed/apply-time values, remote state contents and actual remote resource identities remain terminal runtime ceilings
dynamic block expansion cardinality/values and count/for_each instance keys are not evaluated; authored meta/dynamic syntax is materialized
module providers object entries are materialized as exact source mappings; arbitrary nested authored object/list ownership requires the generic bounded structured-path primitive
function/index/splat traversal source structure beyond retained direct shapes requires the generic bounded expression-path primitive
conditional/template effective value normalization requires HCL evaluation and is outside the source-only Framework contract
import/moved/removed block attributes are materialized as authored control entities but target address normalization is generic Terraform address normalization, not Framework execution
